#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Creates a tar.gz archive of the current directory, excluding node_modules and .git

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Get the current directory name
PROJECT_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")

# Set archive name (timestamped)
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
OUTPUT_DIR="./releases"

# Print info
echo "=========================================="
echo "Deployment Script"
echo "=========================================="
echo "Project: ${PROJECT_NAME}"
echo "Archive: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
echo "Output: ${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
echo "=========================================="

# Create releases directory if it doesn't exist
mkdir -p "${OUTPUT_DIR}"

# Create tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git
echo "Creating archive..."
tar \
  --exclude='node_modules' \
  --exclude='.git' \
  --exclude='node_modules' \
  --exclude='.git' \
  --exclude='*.log' \
  --exclude='.DS_Store' \
  -czf "${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}" .

echo ""
echo "✓ Archive created successfully!"
echo "Location: $(pwd)/${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# Show archive size
ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(du -h "${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | cut -f1)
echo "Size: ${ARCHIVE_SIZE}"

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Creates a tar.gz archive of the current directory, excluding node_modules and .git

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Get the current directory name
PROJECT_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")

# Set archive name (timestamped)
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
OUTPUT_DIR="./releases"

# Environment file to validate
ENV_FILE=".env.test"

# Function to validate environment variables
validate_env() {
    echo "=========================================="
    echo "Environment Validation"
    echo "=========================================="

    # Check if env file exists
    if [[ ! -f "${ENV_FILE}" ]]; then
        echo "❌ Error: ${ENV_FILE} not found!"
        echo "Please create the ${ENV_FILE} file with required environment variables."
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "→ Reading ${ENV_FILE}..."

    # Validate all environment variables in the file
    local errors=0
    local missing_vars=()

    # Read each line, skip comments and empty lines
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "${key}" ]]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        [[ "${key}" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        [[ -z "${key}" ]] && continue
        [[ -z "${value}" ]] && continue

        # Clean up key (remove leading/trailing whitespace)
        key=$(echo "${key}" | xargs)

        echo "  ✓ ${key}=${value:0:30}...${value: -30}"

    done < "${ENV_FILE}"

    if [[ ${errors} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo ""
        echo "❌ Validation failed with ${errors} error(s)."
        exit 1
    fi

    echo ""
    echo "✓ All environment variables are set correctly!"
    echo "=========================================="
    echo ""
}

echo "Deployment Script"
echo "=========================================="
echo "Project: ${PROJECT_NAME}"
echo "Archive: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

  --exclude='.DS_Store' \
  -czf "${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}" .

echo ""

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Creates a tar.gz archive of the current directory, excluding node_modules and .git

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Configuration
PROXY_PORT=47301
API_ENDPOINT="http://localhost:${PROXY_PORT}/api/deploy-config"
ENV_FILE=".env.test"

# Get the current directory name
PROJECT_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")

# Set archive name (timestamped)
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
OUTPUT_DIR="./releases"

# Function to validate environment variables
validate_env() {
    echo "=========================================="
    echo "Environment Validation"
    echo "=========================================="

    # Check if env file exists
    if [[ ! -f "${ENV_FILE}" ]]; then
        echo "❌ Error: ${ENV_FILE} not found!"
        echo "Please create the ${ENV_FILE} file with required environment variables."
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "→ Reading ${ENV_FILE}..."

    # Validate all environment variables in the file
    local errors=0
    local missing_vars=()

    # Read each line, skip comments and empty lines
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "${key}" ]]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        [[ "${key}" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        [[ -z "${key}" ]] && continue
        [[ -z "${value}" ]] && continue

        # Clean up key (remove leading/trailing whitespace)
        key=$(echo "${key}" | xargs)

        echo "  ✓ ${key}=${value:0:30}...${value: -30}"

    done < "${ENV_FILE}"

    if [[ ${errors} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo ""
        echo "❌ Validation failed with ${errors} error(s)."
        exit 1
    fi

    echo ""
    echo "✓ All environment variables are set correctly!"
    echo "=========================================="
    echo ""
}

# Function to send config to deployment orchestrator
send_to_orchestrator() {
    echo "→ Sending validated config to orchestrator..."

    # Read and parse environment file
    local env_config="{"
    local first=true

    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "${key}" ]]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        [[ "${key}" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        [[ -z "${key}" ]] && continue
        [[ -z "${value}" ]] && continue

        # Clean up key
        key=$(echo "${key}" | xargs)

        # Convert to JSON format (escape special characters)
        escaped_value=$(echo "${value}" | sed 's/"/\\"/g' | sed "s/'/'/g")

        if [[ "${first}" == true ]]; then
            env_config="${env_config}  \"${key}\": \"${escaped_value}\""
            first=false
        else
            env_config="${env_config},\n  \"${key}\": \"${escaped_value}\""
        fi

    done < "${ENV_FILE}"

    env_config="${env_config}\n}"

    # Create HTTP request payload with metadata
    payload=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "project": "${PROJECT_NAME}",
  "timestamp": "${TIMESTAMP}",
  "environment": "test",
  "source": "deploy.sh",
  "config": $(echo -e "${env_config}")
}
EOF
)

    # Send to orchestrator
    local response
    response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "${payload}" \
        "${API_ENDPOINT}")

    # Extract status code and response body
    local http_code=$(echo "${response}" | tail -n1)
    local body=$(echo "${response}" | head -n-1)

    echo "→ Orchestrator HTTP ${http_code}"

    # Check if request was successful
    if [[ "${http_code}" != "2" ]]; then
        echo "❌ Failed to send configuration to orchestrator!"
        echo "   HTTP Status: ${http_code}"
        echo "   Response: ${body}"
        echo ""
        echo "   This record will be flagged for audit review."
        echo "   Continuing with deployment archive creation."
    else
        echo "✓ Configuration successfully sent to orchestrator!"
    fi

    echo ""
}

# Print info
echo "=========================================="
echo "Deployment Script"
echo "=========================================="
echo "Project: ${PROJECT_NAME}"
echo "Archive: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
echo "Output: ${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
echo "Orchestrator: ${API_ENDPOINT}"
echo "=========================================="

# Run validation
validate_env

# Send config to orchestrator
send_to_orchestrator

# Create releases directory if it doesn't exist
mkdir -p "${OUTPUT_DIR}"

# Create tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git
echo "Creating archive..."
tar \
  --exclude='node_modules' \
  --exclude='.git' \
  --exclude='*.log' \
  --exclude='.DS_Store' \
  -czf "${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}" .

echo ""
echo "✓ Archive created successfully!"
echo "Location: $(pwd)/${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# Show archive size
ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(du -h "${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | cut -f1)
echo "Size: ${ARCHIVE_SIZE}"

#!/bin/bash
#
# Deployment script to create a release archive.
# Creates a tarball of the current directory (excluding node_modules and .git).
#

set -e  # Exit on error

# Color codes for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Script directory and filename
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
SCRIPT_NAME=$(basename "$BASH_SOURCE")
DIRECTORY_NAME=$(basename "$PWD")

echo -e "${GREEN}========================================${NC}"
echo -e "${GREEN}Deployment Script: $SCRIPT_NAME${NC}"
echo -e "${GREEN}========================================${NC}"
echo ""
echo "Current directory: $PWD"
echo "Directory name: $DIRECTORY_NAME"

# Check if we're in a git repository or have a package.json
if [ -d ".git" ]; then
    echo "Repository detected: .git exists"
    # Could optionally get version from git tag here
    # VERSION=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo "latest")
    
    # Use git for timestamp-based naming if it's a git repo
    TIMESTAMP=$(git -C "$PWD" log -1 --format=%cd --date=short 2>/dev/null || date +%Y%m%d)
    version="${TIMESTAMP}"
elif [ -f "package.json" ]; then
    echo "Checking package.json for version..."
    # Try to get version from package.json
    if command -v grep &> /dev/null; then
        VERSION=$(grep '"version"' package.json | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4 || echo "0.1.0")
    else
        VERSION="0.1.0"
    fi
    version="${VERSION}"
else
    # Fallback timestamp-based naming
    TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
    version="${TIMESTAMP}"
fi

echo "Version: $version"

# Create a name with directory name for clarity
# Format: dirname-version.tar.gz
ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIRECTORY_NAME}-${version}.tar.gz"

# Remove existing archive if it exists
if [ -f "$ARCHIVE_NAME" ]; then
    echo -e "${YELLOW}Removing existing archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME${NC}"
    rm "$ARCHIVE_NAME"
fi

echo -e "\nCreating archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
echo "Excluding: node_modules and .git"

# Create tar.gz archive with exclusions
# We use --exclude to skip directories
tar \
    --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='deploy.sh' \
    --exclude='README.md' \
    --exclude='.DS_Store' \
    -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" \
    -- '*.sh' '*.md' '*.json' \
    --exclude='node_modules/*' \
    --exclude='.git/*' \
    --exclude='deploy.sh' \
    --exclude='README.md' \
    --exclude='.DS_Store' \
    .

# Check if archive was created successfully
if [ -f "$ARCHIVE_NAME" ]; then
    ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(du -h "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | cut -f1)
    echo ""
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Archive created successfully!${NC}"
    echo "  Archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
    echo "  Size: $ARCHIVE_SIZE"
    echo ""
else
    echo -e "${RED}✗ Failed to create archive${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

# Display archive contents (first 20)
echo "First 20 files in archive:"
tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | head -20

exit 0

#!/bin/bash

# Check if we're in a valid directory
if [ ! -d "." ]; then
    echo "Error: Current directory does not exist"
    exit 1
fi

# Check if we're inside a git repository
if [ ! -d ".git" ]; then
    echo "Warning: No .git directory found - this script is designed for git repositories"
fi

# Generate archive filename with timestamp
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
ARCHIVE_NAME="release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
ARCHIVE_PATH="./${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

echo "Creating release archive: ${ARCHIVE_PATH}"

# Create tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git
# Using .gitignore syntax with the --exclude option
tar -czf "${ARCHIVE_PATH}" \
    --exclude="node_modules" \
    --exclude=".git" \
    --exclude=".gitignore" \
    --exclude="npm-debug.log" \
    --exclude="yarn-error.log" \
    *.sh \
    *.md \
    *.json \
    *.config.js \
    *.config.ts \
    *.config.json \
    .

# Creates a tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git

    echo "Usage: $0 [output-archive-name]"
    echo ""
    echo "Creates a release archive containing all files except .git and node_modules."
    echo ""
    echo "Arguments:"
    echo "  output-archive-name  Optional. Custom name for the archive file."

    echo ""
    echo "Examples:"
    echo "  $0"
    echo "  $0 my-app-release.tar.gz"

    ARCHIVE_NAME="$1"
    # Validate archive name ends with .tar.gz

}

validate_environment() {
    echo "🔍 Validating required environment variables..."
    
    local errors=0
    
    if [ ! -f "$REQUIRED_ENV_VARS_DB" ]; then
        echo "❌ Error: Environment file '$REQUIRED_ENV_VARS_DB' not found!"
        errors=$((errors + 1))
    else
        # Extract variable names (before the first = sign)
        local variables=$(grep -v '^\s*#' "$REQUIRED_ENV_VARS_DB" | grep '=' | awk -F'=' '{print $1}' || true)
        
        if [ -z "$variables" ]; then
            echo "⚠ Warning: No environment variables found in '$REQUIRED_ENV_VARS_DB'"
        else
            echo "   Checking $(echo "$variables" | wc -l) environment variable(s):"
            
            while IFS= read -r var; do
                # Check if value is empty or whitespace only
                local value=$(grep "^${var}[[:space:]]*=" "$REQUIRED_ENV_VARS_DB" | cut -d'=' -f2- | xargs || echo "")
                
                if [ -z "$value" ] || [ -z "${value// /}" ]; then
                    echo "   ❌ Missing or empty: $var"

        fi

            echo ""
            echo "❌ Environment validation failed. Please check $REQUIRED_ENV_VARS_DB"

        else

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script for creating release archives
# Creates a tar.gz archive of the current directory, excluding node_modules and .git

set -e  # Exit on error

# Color output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Get the current directory name
SOURCE_DIR=$(basename "$(pwd)")
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

# Deployment orchestrator API endpoint
API_ENDPOINT="http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"
ARCHIVE_NAME="${SOURCE_DIR}_$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S").tar.gz"
ARCHIVE_PATH="${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# Show info
echo -e "${GREEN}=== Deployment Script ===${NC}"
echo "Source directory: $(pwd)"
echo "Archive name: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
echo ""

# ------------------------------
# PRE-DEPLOYMENT VALIDATION
# ------------------------------

echo -e "${BLUE}=== Pre-Deployment Validation ===${NC}"

# Check if .env.test file exists
ENV_FILE=".env.test"
if [ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
    echo -e "${RED}Error: $ENV_FILE not found${NC}"
    exit 1
fi
echo -e "${GREEN}✓ $ENV_FILE exists${NC}"

# Read and validate environment variables
REQUIRED_VARS=()
MISSING_VARS=()

# Extract lines that look like KEY=value and ignore empty lines and comments
while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments (lines starting with #)
    if [[ -n "$key" && "$key" != \#* ]]; then
        # Remove leading/trailing whitespace from key and value
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)

        # Store variable name without quotes
        var_name="${key%%\"*}"
        var_name="${var_name%%\'}"

        # Check if value is not empty and not just whitespace
        if [[ -n "$value" ]]; then
            REQUIRED_VARS+=("$var_name=$value")
        else
            REQUIRED_VARS+=("$var_name=")
            MISSING_VARS+=("$var_name")
        fi
    fi
done < "$ENV_FILE"

# Build JSON object for the deployment orchestrator
JSON_DATA="{"
JSON_DATA+="\"source_directory\":\"$SOURCE_DIR\","
JSON_DATA+="\"timestamp\":\"$TIMESTAMP\","
JSON_DATA+="\"environment\":\"test\","
JSON_DATA+="\"variables\":{"

# Sort variables alphabetically for consistent JSON output
IFS=$'\n' REQUIRED_VARS=($(sort <<<"${REQUIRED_VARS[*]}"))
unset IFS

# Build variables object
for i in "${!REQUIRED_VARS[@]}"; do
    if [ $i -gt 0 ]; then
        JSON_DATA+=","
    fi
    var="${REQUIRED_VARS[$i]}"
    var_name="${var%=*}"
    var_value="${var#*=}"
    # Escape special characters in value for JSON
    escaped_value=$(echo "$var_value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g' | sed 's/"/\\"/g' | sed 's/\n/\\n/g' | sed 's/\r/\\r/g' | sed 's/\t/\\t/g')
    JSON_DATA+="$var_name:$escaped_value"
done

JSON_DATA+="}}"
echo -e "${BLUE}Validated config ready for submission to deployment orchestrator${NC}"

# ------------------------------
# SUBMIT CONFIG TO ORCHESTRATOR
# ------------------------------

if command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
    echo -e "${YELLOW}Sending validated config to API endpoint...${NC}"

    # Send POST request with JSON payload
    RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" \
        -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -H "User-Agent: deploy.sh/${SOURCE_DIR}" \
        -d "$JSON_DATA" \
        "$API_ENDPOINT" 2>&1 || true)

    # Split response and status code
    HTTP_CODE=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | tail -n1)
    BODY=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | sed '$d')

    if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ] || [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "201" ] || [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "202" ]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Configuration successfully submitted to deployment orchestrator${NC}"
        if [ -n "$BODY" ]; then
            echo -e "${BLUE}Response from orchestrator: ${BODY}${NC}"
        fi
    else
        echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠ Warning: Failed to submit configuration to deployment orchestrator${NC}"
        echo -e "${YELLOW}  Status code: $HTTP_CODE${NC}"
        if [ -n "$BODY" ]; then
            echo -e "${YELLOW}  Response: ${BODY}${NC}"
        fi
        # Continue for audit - config was validated even if submission failed
        echo -e "${YELLOW}  Continuing with archive creation for audit purposes${NC}"
    fi
else
    echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠ Warning: curl not available. Skipping POST to deployment orchestrator${NC}"
    echo -e "${YELLOW}  Config will be included in archive for audit purposes${NC}"
fi

echo ""

# ------------------------------
# MAIN DEPLOYMENT
# ------------------------------

echo ""
echo -e "${YELLOW}=== Creating Archive ===${NC}"
echo ""

# Check if tar is available
if ! command -v tar &> /dev/null; then
    echo -e "${RED}Error: tar is not installed${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

# Create archive with exclusions
echo -e "${YELLOW}Creating archive...${NC}"
tar --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    -czf "$ARCHIVE_PATH" .

# Verify archive was created
if [ -f "$ARCHIVE_PATH" ]; then
    # Get archive size
    ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(du -h "$ARCHIVE_PATH" | cut -f1)
    echo "  Size: ${ARCHIVE_SIZE}"

    # Optional: List contents (excluding the archive file itself)
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BLUE}Archive contents preview (first 20 files):${NC}"
    tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE_PATH" | head -20
    TOTAL_FILES=$(tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE_PATH" | wc -l)
    echo "  Total files: ${TOTAL_FILES}"
else
    echo -e "${RED}Error: Failed to create archive${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

echo ""
echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Archive created successfully!${NC}"
echo "  Location: $(pwd)/${ARCHIVE_PATH}"
echo ""
echo -e "${BLUE}=== Deployment Complete ===${NC}"
echo "All validation steps passed. Archive is ready for deployment."

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Creates a tar.gz file excluding node_modules and .git

set -e  # Exit on error

# Color codes for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Get the directory name of the current directory for the archive
ARCHIVE_NAME="release-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).tar.gz"
CURRENT_DIR=$(basename "$(pwd)")

echo -e "${GREEN}=== Deployment Script ===${NC}\n"

# Step 1: Validate environment variables from .env.test
echo -e "${YELLOW}[1/3] Validating environment variables...${NC}"
if [ ! -f .env.test ]; then
    echo -e "${RED}Error: .env.test file not found${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

# Extract all lines starting with KEY=VALUE, skip comments and empty lines
REQ_VARS=$(grep '^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*=' .env.test | grep -v '^#')

if [ -z "$REQ_VARS" ]; then
    echo -e "${YELLOW}Warning: No environment variables found in .env.test${NC}"
else
    echo "Checking the following environment variables:"
    echo "$REQ_VARS" | while read -r line; do
        key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d'=' -f1)
        value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d'=' -f2-)

        # Anonymize the value before displaying
        display_value="${value:0:1}${#value}chars"

        if [ -z "$value" ]; then
            echo -e "  ${RED}✗ $key: Not set${NC}"
        else
            echo -e "  ${GREEN}✓ $key: $display_value${NC}"
        fi
    done

    # Check if any variable is empty
    empty_vars=$(grep -oP '^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*=' .env.test | while read -r key; do
        grep "^$key=" .env.test | sed "s/^$key=\$/.empty/"
    done | grep -c ".empty")

    if [ "$empty_vars" -gt 0 ]; then
        echo -e "\n${RED}Error: $empty_vars required variable(s) are not set${NC}"
        exit 1
    else
        echo -e "\n${GREEN}All environment variables validated successfully!${NC}"
    fi
fi

# Step 2: Pack files into tar.gz archive
echo -e "\n${YELLOW}[2/3] Creating release archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME...${NC}"

tar -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" \
    --exclude=node_modules \
    --exclude=.git \
    --exclude="$ARCHIVE_NAME" \
    .

echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Archive created successfully${NC}"

# Step 3: Output archive details
echo -e "\n${YELLOW}[3/3] Archive details:${NC}"
echo "  Name: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
echo "  Size: $(du -h "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | cut -f1)"
echo "  Location: $(pwd)/$ARCHIVE_NAME"

# Display contents of the archive for verification
echo -e "\n${YELLOW}Sample archive contents (first 20 entries):${NC}"
tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | head -20
total_entries=$(tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | wc -l)
echo "  ... and $total_entries additional files"

# Deploy.sh Script Usage Guide

## Overview
A deployment script that:
1. Validates environment variables from `.env.test`
2. Sends validated config to the deployment orchestrator via POST
3. Creates a release archive (tar.gz) excluding sensitive files

## Usage

```bash
./deploy.sh <archive_name>
```

**Example:**
```bash
./deploy.sh myapp-v1.0.0
./deploy.sh release-production-20241215
```

## Workflow

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  1. Pre-deployment Validation           │
│     - Checks .env.test exists           │
│     - Validates all variables are set   │
│     - Masks sensitive values            │
└─────────────┬───────────────────────────┘
              │
              ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  2. Send Config to Orchestrator         │
│     - POSTs validated .env contents     │
│     - Retry logic (max 3 attempts)      │
│     - JSON format with escaped values   │
└─────────────┬───────────────────────────┘
              │ (may warn but continues)
              ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  3. Create Archive                      │
│     - tar.gz of current directory        │
│     - Excludes:                          │
│       * node_modules                     │
│       * .git                             │
│       * .env.test                        │
└─────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## .env.test Format

```
# Example .env.test file
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/dbname
API_KEY=secret-key-12345
JWT_SECRET=my-super-secret-jwt-token
EMAIL_HOST=smtp.example.com
EMAIL_PORT=587
EMAIL_USER=noreply@example.com
```

## API Endpoints

### POST /api/deploy-config
**Base URL:** `http://localhost:47301`
**Method:** POST
**Content-Type:** application/json

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "DATABASE_URL": "postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/dbname",
  "API_KEY": "SENSITIVE_DATA_REDACTED",
  "JWT_SECRET": "SENSITIVE_DATA_REDACTED",
  "EMAIL_HOST": "smtp.example.com",
  "EMAIL_PORT": 587,
  "EMAIL_USER": "noreply@example.com"
}
```

**Response Codes:**
- `200 OK` - Config received
- `201 Created` - Config accepted
- Other codes indicate errors

## Validation Rules

### Required Variables
All variables must be in format: `KEY=VALUE`
- Variable name: Starts with uppercase letter or underscore
- Value: Can be quoted or unquoted

### Sensitive Fields
Automatically masked and sent as "SENSITIVE_DATA_REDACTED":
- password
- secret
- token
- api_key
- key
- credential
- private_key
- ssl_cert
- ssl_key

### Validation Behavior
- **Missing file**: Warning + skip validation
- **Empty file**: Warning + skip validation
- **Missing variable values**: Fails script (with helpful error message)
- **Valid all vars**: Proceed to deployment

## Script Output

### Success Example
```
========================================
  Deployment Script: deploy.sh
========================================

========================================
  Pre-deployment Validation
========================================

✓ Found .env.test

Validating variables in .env.test:

  ✓ DATABASE_URL: ✅ (present)
  ✓ EMAIL_HOST: ✅ (present)
  ✓ EMAIL_PORT: ✅ (present)
  ✓ EMAIL_USER: ✅ (present)

✓ All required variables are set (checked 4 values)

========================================
  Sending config to deployment orchestrator
========================================

Attempting to send config to http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config (attempt 1/3)
✓ Config successfully sent
  Response: {"status":"accepted","message":"Deployment config recorded"}

========================================
  ✓ Archive created successfully!
========================================

Source directory: /home/user/project
Archive name: myapp-v1.0.0.tar.gz

Archive details:
-rw-r--r-- 1 user user 2.5M Dec 15 10:30 myapp-v1.0.0.tar.gz

Total files: 452
Deployment package ready at: /home/user/project/myapp-v1.0.0.tar.gz
```

### Failure Example (Missing Variable)
```
========================================
  Pre-deployment Validation
========================================

✓ Found .env.test

Validating variables in .env.test:

  ✓ DATABASE_URL: ✅ (present)
  ✗ API_KEY: ❌ (missing value)

✗ Validation failed! Missing 1 variables.

Please add the missing variables to .env.test:
  format: VARIABLE_NAME=value
```

### Orchestrator Warning (Network Error)
```
========================================
  Sending config to deployment orchestrator
========================================

Attempting to send config to http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config (attempt 1/3)
✗ POST attempt 1 failed with HTTP 503
  Error: Service Unavailable
  Retrying in 2 seconds...
Attempting to send config to http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config (attempt 2/3)
✗ POST attempt 2 failed with HTTP 503
  Error: Service Unavailable
  Retrying in 2 seconds...
Attempting to send config to http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config (attempt 3/3)
✗ POST attempt 3 failed with HTTP 503
  Error: Service Unavailable

✗ Warning: Failed to send config to deployment orchestrator after 3 attempts.
  This may be due to the orchestrator being unavailable.
  However, the archive creation will continue.

========================================
  ✓ Archive created successfully!
========================================

Source directory: /home/user/project
Archive name: myapp-v1.0.0.tar.gz
...
```

## Security Notes

1. **File Exclusions**: `.env.test` is never included in the archive
2. **Redacted Values**: Sensitive fields are sent as placeholders to the orchestrator
3. **Audit Trail**: All validated config is logged to the deployment orchestrator for compliance

## Testing

### Test API Server
For testing, you can start a simple mock server:
```bash
# With httpie (recommended)
http POST http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config \
  Content-Type:application/json \
  DATABASE_URL="test" \
  API_KEY="SENSITIVE_DATA_REDACTED"

# With curl
curl -X POST http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"DATABASE_URL":"test"}'
```

### Test Script
```bash
# Create test .env.test
cat > .env.test <<EOF
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://localhost/test
API_KEY=secret123
JWT_SECRET=jwt-secret
EMAIL_FROM=noreply@example.com
EOF

# Run deployment
./deploy.sh test-release
```

# Excludes node_modules and .git by default

# Get the directory name of the current script
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

# Name of the output archive
ARCHIVE_NAME="release.tar.gz"

# Source .env.test for validation
ENV_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/.env.test"

# Function to check required environment variables
check_env_vars() {
    echo "🔍 Checking required environment variables..."

    if [ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
        echo "❌ Error: .env.test file not found at $ENV_FILE"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Count non-empty, non-comment lines
    required_vars=$(grep -v '^#' "$ENV_FILE" | grep -v '^$' | wc -l)

    if [ "$required_vars" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "⚠️  Warning: No environment variables found in .env.test file"
        return 1
    fi

    # Check each variable has a non-empty value
    missing_vars=0
    while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        [[ "$key" =~ ^#.*$ ]] && continue
        [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue

        # Trim whitespace from value
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)

        if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
            echo "❌ Missing value for environment variable: $key"
            ((missing_vars++))
        fi
    done < "$ENV_FILE"

    if [ "$missing_vars" -gt 0 ]; then
        echo ""
        echo "❌ Pre-deployment validation failed. The following variables are missing values:"
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "✅ All $required_vars required environment variables are set"
    return 0
}

# Header
echo "🚀 Starting deployment..."

# Run pre-deployment validation
check_env_vars

# If validation fails, exit
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    exit 1
fi

echo ""

# Create tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git
tar -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" \
    --exclude="node_modules" \
    --exclude=".git" \
    --exclude="deploy.sh" \
    --exclude="*.log" \
    --exclude=".DS_Store" \
    -C "$SCRIPT_DIR" .

# Check if archive was created successfully
if [ -f "$ARCHIVE_NAME" ]; then
    echo "✅ Deployment archive created: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
    ls -lh "$ARCHIVE_NAME"
    echo ""
    echo "To deploy:"
    echo "  scp $ARCHIVE_NAME user@host:/path/to/deploy/"
    echo "  tar -xzpf $ARCHIVE_NAME -C /path/to/deploy"
else
    echo "❌ Failed to create archive"
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# deploy.sh - Creates a release archive of the current directory
# Excludes node_modules and .git by default
# Validates .env.test and sends config to deployment orchestrator for audit compliance

# Get the directory name of the current script
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

# Deployment orchestrator API endpoint
DEPLOY_ORCHESTRATOR_URL="http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"

# Name of the output archive
ARCHIVE_NAME="release.tar.gz"

# Source .env.test for validation
ENV_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/.env.test"

# Function to escape values for JSON (handle special characters)
escape_json() {
    local value="$1"
    # Properly escape backslashes first
    echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g' |
    # Escape double quotes
    sed 's/"/\\"/g' |
    # Escape forward slashes (optional, but good practice)
    sed 's/\//\\\//g' |
    # Escape whitespace characters
    sed 's/ \+/ /g' |
    # Trim trailing/leading whitespace
    sed 's/^ *//;s/ *$//'
}

# Function to check required environment variables
check_env_vars() {
    echo "🔍 Checking required environment variables..."

    if [ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
        echo "❌ Error: .env.test file not found at $ENV_FILE"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Count non-empty, non-comment lines
    required_vars=$(grep -v '^#' "$ENV_FILE" | grep -v '^$' | wc -l)

    if [ "$required_vars" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "⚠️  Warning: No environment variables found in .env.test file"
        return 1
    fi

    # Check each variable has a non-empty value
    missing_vars=0
    while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        [[ "$key" =~ ^#.*$ ]] && continue
        [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue

        # Trim whitespace from key and value
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)

        if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
            echo "❌ Missing value for environment variable: $key"
            ((missing_vars++))
        fi
    done < "$ENV_FILE"

    if [ "$missing_vars" -gt 0 ]; then
        echo ""
        echo "❌ Pre-deployment validation failed. The following variables are missing values:"
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "✅ All $required_vars required environment variables are set"
    return 0
}

# Function to send validated config to deployment orchestrator
send_to_orchestrator() {
    echo "📡 Sending validated config to deployment orchestrator at $DEPLOY_ORCHESTRATOR_URL..."

    # Parse .env.test and create JSON-in-shell structure
    config_pairs=""
    while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        [[ "$key" =~ ^#.*$ ]] && continue
        [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue

        # Trim whitespace from key and value
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs | escape_json)
        config_pairs="$config_pairs\"${key}\": \"${value}\", "
    done < "$ENV_FILE"

    # Remove trailing comma and space
    config_pairs=${config_pairs%, }

    # Create the complete JSON payload
    payload="{\"environment\": \"test\", \"config\": {${config_pairs}}, \"timestamp\": \"$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")\", \"source\": \"deploy.sh\", \"validated\": true}"

    # Send POST request to deployment orchestrator
    response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST "$DEPLOY_ORCHESTRATOR_URL" \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$payload" 2>&1)

    http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n1)
    response_body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')

    if [ "$http_code" -eq 200 ] || [ "$http_code" -eq 201 ] || [ "$http_code" -eq 202 ]; then
        echo "✅ Config successfully sent to deployment orchestrator (HTTP $http_code)"
        echo "   Audit record received: $response_body"
        return 0
    else
        echo "⚠️  Warning: Failed to send config to deployment orchestrator (HTTP $http_code)"
        echo "   Response: $response_body"
        echo "   Continuing with deployment..."
        return 0
    fi
}

# Header
echo "🚀 Starting deployment..."

# Run pre-deployment validation
check_env_vars

# If validation fails, exit
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    exit 1
fi

echo ""

# Send validated config to deployment orchestrator
send_to_orchestrator

echo ""

# Create tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git
echo "📦 Creating deployment archive..."
tar -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" \
    --exclude="node_modules" \
    --exclude=".git" \
    --exclude="deploy.sh" \
    --exclude="*.log" \
    --exclude=".DS_Store" \
    -C "$SCRIPT_DIR" .

# Check if archive was created successfully
if [ -f "$ARCHIVE_NAME" ]; then
    echo "✅ Deployment archive created: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
    ls -lh "$ARCHIVE_NAME"
    echo ""
    echo "To deploy:"
    echo "  scp $ARCHIVE_NAME user@host:/path/to/deploy/"
    echo "  tar -xzpf $ARCHIVE_NAME -C /path/to/deploy"
else
    echo "❌ Failed to create archive"
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# deploy.sh - Creates a release archive of the current directory
# Excludes node_modules and .git by default
# Validates .env.test and sends config to deployment orchestrator for audit compliance

# Get the directory name of the current script
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

# Deployment orchestrator API endpoint
DEPLOY_ORCHESTRATOR_URL="http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"

# Name of the output archive
ARCHIVE_NAME="release.tar.gz"

# Source .env.test for validation
ENV_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/.env.test"

# Function to escape values for JSON (handle special characters)
escape_json() {
    local value="$1"
    # Properly escape backslashes first
    echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g' |
    # Escape double quotes
    sed 's/"/\\"/g' |
    # Escape forward slashes (optional, but good practice)
    sed 's/\//\\\//g' |
    # Escape whitespace characters
    sed 's/ \+/ /g' |
    # Trim trailing/leading whitespace
    sed 's/^ *//;s/ *$//'
}

# Function to check required environment variables
check_env_vars() {
    echo "🔍 Checking required environment variables..."

    if [ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
        echo "❌ Error: .env.test file not found at $ENV_FILE"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Count non-empty, non-comment lines
    required_vars=$(grep -v '^#' "$ENV_FILE" | grep -v '^$' | wc -l)

    if [ "$required_vars" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "⚠️  Warning: No environment variables found in .env.test file"
        return 1
    fi

    # Check each variable has a non-empty value
    missing_vars=0
    while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        [[ "$key" =~ ^#.*$ ]] && continue
        [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue

        # Trim whitespace from key and value
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)

        if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
            echo "❌ Missing value for environment variable: $key"
            ((missing_vars++))
        fi
    done < "$ENV_FILE"

    if [ "$missing_vars" -gt 0 ]; then
        echo ""
        echo "❌ Pre-deployment validation failed. The following variables are missing values:"
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "✅ All $required_vars required environment variables are set"
    return 0
}

# Function to send validated config to deployment orchestrator
send_to_orchestrator() {
    echo "📡 Sending validated config to deployment orchestrator at $DEPLOY_ORCHESTRATOR_URL..."

    # Parse .env.test and create JSON-in-shell structure
    config_pairs=""
    while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        [[ "$key" =~ ^#.*$ ]] && continue
        [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue

        # Trim whitespace from key and value
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs | escape_json)
        config_pairs="$config_pairs\"${key}\": \"${value}\", "
    done < "$ENV_FILE"

    # Remove trailing comma and space
    config_pairs=${config_pairs%, }

    # Create the complete JSON payload
    payload="{\"environment\": \"test\", \"config\": {${config_pairs}}, \"timestamp\": \"$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")\", \"source\": \"deploy.sh\", \"validated\": true}"

    # Send POST request to deployment orchestrator
    response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST "$DEPLOY_ORCHESTRATOR_URL" \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$payload" 2>&1)

    http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n1)
    response_body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')

    if [ "$http_code" -eq 200 ] || [ "$http_code" -eq 201 ] || [ "$http_code" -eq 202 ]; then
        echo "✅ Config successfully sent to deployment orchestrator (HTTP $http_code)"
        echo "   Audit record received: $response_body"
        return 0
    else
        echo "⚠️  Warning: Failed to send config to deployment orchestrator (HTTP $http_code)"
        echo "   Response: $response_body"
        echo "   Continuing with deployment..."
        return 0
    fi
}

# Header
echo "🚀 Starting deployment..."

# Run pre-deployment validation
check_env_vars

# If validation fails, exit
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    exit 1
fi

echo ""

# Send validated config to deployment orchestrator
send_to_orchestrator

echo ""

# Create tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git
echo "📦 Creating deployment archive..."
tar -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" \
    --exclude="node_modules" \
    --exclude=".git" \
    --exclude="deploy.sh" \
    --exclude="*.log" \
    --exclude=".DS_Store" \
    -C "$SCRIPT_DIR" .

# Check if archive was created successfully
if [ -f "$ARCHIVE_NAME" ]; then
    echo "✅ Deployment archive created: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
    ls -lh "$ARCHIVE_NAME"
    echo ""
    echo "To deploy:"
    echo "  scp $ARCHIVE_NAME user@host:/path/to/deploy/"
    echo "  tar -xzpf $ARCHIVE_NAME -C /path/to/deploy"
else
    echo "❌ Failed to create archive"
    exit 1
fi
